name: Kateryna Shevchuk
headline: Platform Engineer
summary: Platform engineer with a track record of improving deployment reliability, infrastructure consistency, and operational readiness across cloud environments. Experienced in supporting cross-functional delivery with Agile practices and automation-focused platform work. Comfortable partnering with product and engineering teams to simplify complex systems and keep releases moving smoothly.

roles.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
bullets: Streamlined environment setup and server provisioning with Ansible and AWS, reducing manual effort by 40% for the delivery team.
Supported container orchestration on Kubernetes and kept SQL-backed services aligned with release changes through routine checks and fixes.
Worked in Agile planning sessions to prioritize platform tasks and resolve delivery blockers before they affected the sprint.
Improved rollback readiness for cloud infrastructure updates by documenting repeatable procedures and validating changes with the team.

roles.title: Platform Engineer
bullets: Built and maintained deployment paths with Ansible, AWS and Helm, improving release consistency across Kubernetes clusters.
Coordinated platform work for Microservices and MLOps workloads across GCP and AWS, helping teams ship changes with fewer handoffs.
Reviewed SQL-based operational data to spot service issues early and cut repeat incidents by 25%.
Standardized cluster configuration with Kubernetes and Helm so application teams could follow the same release pattern across environments.

roles.title: Senior Platform Engineer
bullets: Led platform standardization across AWS and Azure by combining Terraform, Ansible and Kubernetes for repeatable environment delivery.
Designed release workflows with CI/CD, Docker and GitHub Actions to speed up delivery and reduce failed deployments by 30%.
Operated Helm-based Kubernetes packaging for Microservices and kept service updates predictable across shared environments.
Supported Spark and SQL workloads on cloud infrastructure while improving reliability through clear runbooks and change control.
Partnered with engineering teams in Agile delivery cycles to remove blockers and keep platform changes aligned with business priorities.
